definitions.explanation: A woven or knotted structure of threads, cords, or wires used for catching, holding, or separating things.
A figurative net or system that spreads out to cover an area, such as a transportation network or a web of connections.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}を{網|あみ}で{捕|と}る。
{窓|まど}に{虫除|むしよ}けの{網|あみ}を{張|は}った。
examples.english: I put up an insect screen on the window.

examples.japanese: バーベキューで{肉|にく}を{焼|や}くための{網|あみ}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared a grill mesh for barbecuing meat.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}の{網|あみ}が{広|ひろ}がる。
{交通|こうつう}の{網|あみ}が{全国|ぜんこく}に{張|は}り{巡|めぐ}らされている。
examples.english: A transportation network is spread across the entire country.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{警察|けいさつ}の{網|あみ}をくぐり{抜|ぬ}けて{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: The criminal slipped through the police net and escaped.

notes:
A fundamental word referring to any kind of net or mesh structure. In the literal sense, it covers fishing nets, insect screens, grill grates, and similar items. In the figurative sense, it describes systems or webs that spread out and enclose, such as a dragnet or transportation network.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {網|あみ}を{張|は}る: to set up a net; to cast a net
- {網|あみ}に{掛|か}かる: to be caught in a net
- {網|あみ}をくぐる: to slip through a net
- {網|あみ}を{広|ひろ}げる: to spread a net
- {金|かな}{網|あみ}: wire mesh
- {漁|りょう}{網|あみ}: fishing net

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ネット: net — the English loanword, used especially for sports nets and internet
- {網目|あみめ}: mesh pattern — refers specifically to the pattern of the mesh holes
- {蜘蛛|くも}の{巣|す}: spider web — a specific type of natural net
